༄༅// bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor 'chi med grub pa'i lam bzang gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ra we/ pad+ma rā ga'i lhun por nyi 'od kyis// 'khyud pa ji bzhin 'od stong dkrigs pa'i sku// dpag yas tshe yi dbang phyug chen po dang*// dbyer med dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// de nyid lha dgu'i sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du// skal bar ldan pa'i slob ma gzhug pa'i thabs// dbang chog 'chi med grub pa'i lam bzang gi /mtshams sbyor gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me bri// de'ang 'dir bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs kyi tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba don du gnyer ba'i slob ma nang gshin pa gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa rnams khrus byas/ phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul nas gral du 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gyis zang zing med pa'i byams pa dang*/ 'khor ba las sgrol 'dod kyi snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo nyan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang snyam pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun spyod thams cad gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de'ang 'o skol rnams dal 'byor gyi lus thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blangs pas chog pa 'di shin tu skal ba bzang ba yin/ de lta bu'i skabs 'dir dal 'byor gyi lus la snying po blang dgos/ de yang 'jig rten 'di'i bde skyid snyan gsum dang*/ 'jig rten phyi ma'i lha dang mi'i go 'phang la sogs pa ni zag bcas 'khor ba'i bde ba zhes bya ba snying po med pa nges par bslu ba'i chos can kho na yin pas blo bzang rnams kyis don du gnyer bya'i snying po ma yin/

'o na ci zhig don du gnyer bya yin snyam na/ 'o skol rnams khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las thar dgos/ de'ang bdag nyid gcig pus thar bas mi phan/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can thams cad kyis thog ma med pa'i 'khor ba nas 'khor bar bdag gi pha ma byas shing brtse gdung bsam gyis mi khyab pas yang yang bskyangs pa'i drin can sha stag yin/ des na drin can 'di rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god dgos/ de'i nus pa da lta bdag la mi 'dug bdag las lhag pa 'jig rten pa'i chen po rnams dang*/ 'phags pa'i khongs su gtogs pa 'ga' zhig la'ang mi 'dug 'o na su zhig la 'dug na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la mnga' ba 'dug pas/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs la/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba zab mo blangs te dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdam tshul bzhin du bgyi snyam pa mdzod/ bsam pa de lta bu dang ldan pas sgo gsum gyi dge ba ci byas thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur bas/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu myur du thob/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu tshe 'dir tshe ring ba dang nad med pa dang*/ skye ba phyi mar lha dang mi'i go 'phang la sogs pa'ang zhar las 'byung bas 'di shin tu gal che ba lags/ spro na/ de lta bu'i blo can rnams la bdag cag gi ston pa tshad med pa'i thugs rje dang yon tan mnga' ba bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po de nyid kyis 'dul bya rnams kyi bsam pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa rnams bsdu na/ theg pa che chung gnyis su 'dus pa las/ 'di theg pa chen po yin/

de'ang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su yod pa las/ 'dir rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las khyad chos bzhi'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa sngags kyi theg pa yin/ de la rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhi las/ 'dir rig sngags 'chang gi sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la'ang bya ba spyi'i rgyud dang so so'i rgyud gnyis las/ bsdu na 'di phyi ma yin/ de la'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud dang sogs sbrel lo/ /dang po bya ba spyi'i rgyud chen bzhi ni/ bya ba so so'i rgyud du ma tshang ba kha bskang ba dang mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa'i bshad rgyud lta bu ste/ spyad pa bzhi'i don bsdus shing ma tshang ba med par ston pa dpung bzang gi rgyud dang*/ 'jug pa'i spyod pa smin byed dbang gi bya ba gtso bor ston pa gsang ba spyi'i rgyud dang*/ sbyor ba'i spyod pa mtshan bcas lha'i rnal 'byor gtso bor ston pa legs par grub pa'i rgyud dang*/ sgrub pa'i spyod pa mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor gtso bor ston pa bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud dang bzhi yin/ gnyis pa bya ba so so'i rgyud la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ lngas rtsen gyi rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ nor bu'i rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi rgyud dang drug las/ 'di pad+ma'i rigs kyi rgyud yin/ de la'ang rigs kyi gtso bo dang*/ rigs kyi bdag po dang*/ rigs kyi yum dang*/ rigs kyi khro bo khro mo dang*/ rigs kyi bka' nyan pho mo'i rgyud dang lnga las/ 'di rigs kyi gtso bo'i rgyud yin/ de la'ang tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i mdo yongs su rdzogs pa oṃ gsum ma dang oṃ gnyis ma dang*/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs la sogs pa yod pa las 'dir skabs su babs pa ni tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs nas/

mkhas shing grub pa'i slob dpon chen po dze tā ri ste bod skad du dgra las rgyal ba zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis cho ga'i yan lag 'ga' zhig rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang mthun par bkral ba'i bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba bsgrub pa ste/ de la sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyis bya bar 'os pa rnams legs par grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma la bya ba la'ang*/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga dang*/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po slob dpon la mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa dngos yin snyam pa'i mos pa dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ ces brjod/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste sogs zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i lha dang klu dang drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba dpag tu med pa mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par mos pa byas nas/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kun gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis nye bar bstan pa'i stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid can gyi don dam pa byang chub kyi sems tshul bzhin du bsgom par bgyi'o snyam du yi dam 'cha' ba dang*/

yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro snyam pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa dang*/ de'i ched du zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i lam la bslab par bgyi'o snyam pa'i 'jug pa dang*/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig gu snyam pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzad par zhu/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs zhes pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ sngon chad bcom ldan 'das kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'i brdar ras yug dmar po res gdong bcing bar mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wā ra ma nā ya hūm̐/ zhes pas gdong bcings nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba de'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi btub pas/ phyag rten gyi slad du me tog gsar pa'i phreng ba re yang byin par mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes pas byin nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byon nas khyed rnams kyis dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos pa mdzod/ a mṛ ta'i sngags dang las bum gyi chus bsang*/ zhes pas bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad bskrad nas/ rigs nges par bya ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga' zhes dris pa de'i lan btab par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// 'dun pa nges par bya ba'i slad du/ slob dpon gyis des bu la ci zhig bya// zhes dris pa'i sogs gong bzhin brjod/

sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /de'ang sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig ni sangs rgyas kyi sa ste/ de thob par 'dod pa des nang gi sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa gsal btab ste/ zla ba kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ rdo rje don dam byang chub kyi sems te/ de gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ de ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de nyid brtan pa'i slad du khyed rnams kyi snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ slob dpon gyis su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dh+ya badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod pas brtan par byas nas/ gzhan yang 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kun tu spyod pa thams cad snod dang mi ldan pa'i mdun du ma smra zhig ces gsang bar gdams pa ni/ mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes pas gsang bar gdams pa dang bcas pa ni phyi'i 'jug pa yin/ nang 'jug gi slad du slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te khyed rang rnams slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du khrid par mos la/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la 'dud pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i nang du 'khod par mos pa mdzod/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i grub pa dang*/

drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas lus ngag yid gsum gus pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas phyag phul bar bsams la/ thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ na ma ste hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ zhes pas phyag byas nas/ nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la tshe dpag tu med pa dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pa'i rkyen byas pa la brten nas khyed rnams skad cig tsam gyis tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku can re rer gyur pa'i snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dmar po rer gsal btab ste khyed rnams kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig de nyid dang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gnyis ka las 'od zer gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas de thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thams cad 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga nas thim pas tshe dang bsod nams thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab snyam du mos pa mdzod/ slar yang khyed rnams kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig dang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gnyis ka las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang*/

stong 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ khams kyi rgyal phran la sogs pa thams cad kyi lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ dpal 'byor dang*/ gzi brjid thams cad 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par spyan drangs te sogs sngar ltar brjod/ de bzhin du slar yang sogs gong bzhin gyi mthar 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i lha dang klu dang drang srong dang*/ grub pa dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi tshe 'dzin cing tshe gnas pa'i nus pa thams cad 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par bkug ste sogs sngar ltar brjod/ yang gong bzhin gyi mthar rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ dbang thang thams cad dang*/ 'byung ba sa rdo dang*/ ri brag dang*/ rtsi shing dang*/ nags tshal dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ nor bu dang*/ sman dang*/ sgyu rtsal la sogs pa'i bcud thams cad 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par bkug ste sogs sngar ltar brjod/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can dang*/ yon tan dpag tu med pa la sogs pa na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi lus la thim/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas/ thugs rgyud bskul te de rnams las kyang tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byon te khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas mar mtsho chen po la kha ba babs pa ltar sib sib thim pas tshe dang bsod nams sogs gong ltar brjod la/

sde tshan re re bzhin nam thams cad rdzogs pa'i mthar sngags thung gnyis kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra a we sha ya āḥ.āḥzhes pas ye shes phab la/ de ltar ye shes phab pa'i byin rlabs kyis rgyun brtan pa'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag cing*/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod pas snying ga'i hrīḥyig la brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas dkyil 'khor la me tog dbul ba ni/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyang ye shes gcig gi rnam par 'phrul pa yin pas bzang ngan la sogs pa gang yang med mod/ 'on kyang gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir gtso 'khor du bstan pa tsam yin pas rang rang gi las 'brel yod pa'i lha zhig la 'bab par shog cig snyam pa'i sgo nas rim par byon te dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos dbu la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho zhes pas me tog 'bul ba'i tshul mdzod/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de slob dpon gyis blangs nas khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste/ pra t-i grih+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la zhes pas me tog phreng ba'i dbang byin nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyis// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu hūm̐ a zhes pas mig ras dang ma rig pa'i ling tog dus mnyam du bsal bas/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad mthong ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas snyam du mos pa mdzod/ slar yang he badz+ra pā sh+ya zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor la blta bar bskul nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo bstan pa ni/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs te/ phyi rol du me ri rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes shing*/

steng thog rim pa gsum du phub pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang gi lha snam phyogs kyi mdog can gyi dbus su sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang*/ 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re dang bcas pa ni rten gzhal yas khang pa yin la/ brten pa lha ni/ shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lhor rin chen tshe dpag med sogs nas mi g.yo tshe dpag med de brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad tshe dpag tu med pa ste/ lha dgu po thams cad kyang sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la nyi ma sogs nas bzhugs pa dang bcas pa ni brten pa lha ste/ mdor na bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dang mngon sum du mjal ba yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ des dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga rnams grub nas/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la dbang dngos dang mtha' rten sbyin pa gnyis las/ dang po dbang gi dngos gzhi'i chos rnams zhu ba'i slad du maṇ+ḍal dang*/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs nas stsol zhes gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor kun du mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'i khri de nyid kyi steng du/ khyed rang rnams skad cig tsam gyis hrīḥ

dmar po re re de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las zhes snga ma rnams kyis 'di ltar gsungs kyang dkyus tsam gyis kyang chog pas gang mos bya/ dmar po re re de yongs su gyur pa las tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po sogs nas hrīḥdamar po dang bcas pa gsal btab nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad tshe dpag med kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs pa de la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams la thim par mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i lha dang drang srong gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs te khyed rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dbang gi lha de rnams la slob dpon gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang lha'i gtso bo dang slob dpon lhan cig pas rnam snang tshe dpag tu med pa'i rang bzhin can gyi chus yongs su gang ba'i bum pa thogs te khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag ste dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ bum pa so sor yod na rim pa bzhin nam/ gnyis las med na rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ lus la rnam snang sogs nas/ oṃ bai ro tsa na ā yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ bum chu 'thung du gzhug de nas gzhung spro na gong ma gcig gi tshe gzhung gi tshigs bcad 'di yang brjod na legs/

las/ snga ma tshigs bcad de'i mjug tu/ zhes pa'am yang na gzungs kyi ni// phar phyin drug gi tshigs bcad brjod// ces 'byung bas de'ang me tog gtor zhing dril bu bcad gtubs su dkrol la/ sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags// zhes sogs nas/ shes rab mthar phyin tshe yang 'phel bar shog /ces pa'i bar brjod pa'i mthar zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas ye shes kyi chus lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag khyad par du skye ba snga ma rnams su nyon mongs pa gti mug gis kun nas bslangs te gzhan gyi srog bcad pa la brten nas tshe 'dir tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las sgrib ci bsags pa thams cad dag rnam snang tshe dpag tu med pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ slar yang dbang lha'i gtso bo dang slob dpon lhan cig pas/ rdo rje tshe dpag tu med pa'i rang bzhin can gyi chus yongs su gang ba'i bum pa thogs te/ khyed rang gi dpral bar bzhag ste dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ lus la rdo rje'i tshe dbang bskur sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yur+dz+nyā na sogs kyi mthar/ sbyin pa'i sogs 'gre/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi sogs dang*/ rdo rje tshe dpag tu med pas sogs 'dra/ rin chen tshe dpag med dang rna ltag g.yas su sogs gong gis 'gre'o// lus la rin chen tshe dbang*/ oṃ rat+na ā yur+dz+nyā na sogs kyi mthar/ rin chen tshe dpag tu med pas sogs 'dra/ pad+ma tshe dpag med dang ltag par/ lus la pad+ma'i sogs dang*/ oṃ pad+ma ā yur+dz+nyā na sogs dang*/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi sogs dang*/ pad+ma tshe dpag tu med pas sogs 'dra/ las kyi tshe dpag med dang rna ltag g.yon dang*/ lus la las kyi sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra karma ā yur+dz+nyā na sogs dang*/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog sogs dang*/ las kyi tshe dpag tu med pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/

de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun des khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pa gtso bor gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbu brgyan par mos pa mdzod/ de ni chu'i dbang bskur ba yin/ cod paṇa gyi dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyis pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya khyed rnams kyi spyi bor gtugs te/ oṃ pad+mod+bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod pa ni cod paṇa gyi dbang ste/ de ni/ chu yi dbang bskur cod paṇa dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags// zhes gsungs pas/ bya rgyud rang rkang gi lugs kyi dbang gi dngos gzhi ste rdo rje slob dpon du bsgrub pa'i dbang ngo*// gnyis pa dbang gi mtha' rten la gsum las/ rig sngags grub par byed pa sngags kyi bzlas lung ni/ dgos ched khyad par can gyi tshe ma gtogs pa rgyun du mi mdzad la/ bgegs zhi bar bya ba'i phyir bkru byab bsrung gsum las/ thog mar bkru ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te khyed rnams kyi gdong dang yan lag la sogs pa bkrus pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa sgo gsum gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad me long gi g.ya' phyis pa ltar sangs kyis dag par mos pa mdzod ces pa dang*/ rnam rgyal gyi bum pa'i chu cung zad cig las bum du blugs te/ des slob ma'i gdong dang yan lag la sogs pa bkru zhing oṃ na mo bh+rūm̐ zhes sogs snying po dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li zhes sogs kyi mthar/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā sogs nas/ dmu'i gnod pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa ni bkru ba yin/ byab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

rma bya'i mdongs kyi dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig gsal btab ste/ de nyid slob dpon gyis lag gi rdo rje dang lhan cig bzung ste khyed rnams kyi lus la bskor zhing byabs pa la brten nas sgo gsum gyi nad gdon nyer 'tshe thams cad rdo khab len gyis khab len pa ltar blangs te rgya mtsho chen por dor bar mos pa mdzod ces brjod la/ rdo rje dang lhan cig pa'i rma bya'i sgros slob ma la bskor zhing byabs te/ sngags gnyis dang*/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi zhes sogs gong ltar las/ shīn+taṃ gi gnas su a pa na ya swā hā bcug ste byab bo zhes pa ni byabs pa yin/ bsrung ba bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams kyi spyi bo dang mdun rgyab gnyis/ dpung pa gnyis/ pus mo gnyis te/ gnas bdun du rdo rjes rig pas rdo rje de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byung ste/ lus la rdo rje'i go bgos nas phyin chad bdud dang bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod ces brjod/ sngags gnyis dang*/ rdo rje slob ma zhes sogs gong ltar dang kun gyi mthar rak+ṣaḥsbyar la/ rdo rje rgya gram bzhag pas bsrung ngo*// zhes pa ni bsrung ba bya ba ste de dag ni bkru byab bsrung gsum yin/ de nas 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i snying ga'i rtsa bzhi pad 'dab bzhir gyes pa'i dbus su rnam snang tshe dpag med/ shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lhor rin chen tshe dpag med/ nub tu pad+ma tshe dpag med/ byang du las kyi tshe dpag med de gtso 'khor lnga dang spyi bor ye shes tshe dpag med rnams bzhugs par mos nas/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas ye shes tshe dpag tu med pa mar me'i phreng ba ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon te/

khyed rnams kyi spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i ye shes tshe dpag med la thim pas/ de 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur pa spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs te snying ga'i rigs lnga la thim pas rigs lnga zhu ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsis lus thams cad gang ste/ de lus kyi zungs dang sems kyi rten du gyur pas tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos la/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags gsum po bzlas pa'i mthar/ nga ni ye shes tshe dpag med sogs nas rigs 'dzin brnyes/ zhes brjod pa ni byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ de nas/ 'byor pa thob pa'i phyir du shis par bya ba la/ rgyal srid sna bdun sbyin pa dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad sbyin pa'i sgo nas shis par bya ba ste gnyis las/ thog mar rgyal srid sna bdun sbyin pa'i sgo nas shis par bya ba ni/ gnas skabs su 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po thob pa dang tshe dang bsod nams 'phel zhing rgyas par bya ba dang*/ mthar thug tshe dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir rin po che sna bdun gyis dbang bskur ba la thog mar slob dpon gyis oṃ na mo bh+rūm̐ nas hrīḥzhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rin po che sna bdun rim pa bzhin du byin par mos pa mdzod/ lha rdzas las grub lte ba shin tu zlum zhes sogs nas/ oṃ khaḍ+ga rat+na a bhi ṣiñcā mi/ zhes pas byin nas/ gnyis pa bkra shis rdzas brgyad sbyin pa'i sgo nas shis par bya ba ni/ slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs/ bkra shis kyi rdzas la las bum gyi chus gtor te/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṃ las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

oṃ maṅga la aṣ+ṭa dra bya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas byin gyis brlabs te/ me long thogs la/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo sogs nas/ bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi byed shog ces dang*/ slar de dag brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i lha dang drang srong gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas bkra shis kyis mnga' gsol bar mos pa mdzod ces brjod la/ dril bu gsil zhing me tog gtor te/ che ba'i che mchog sogs nas dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir stsol/ rdo rje slob ma rnams spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas bkra shis par gyur cig ces pa ni shes par bya ba ste/ des dbang gi dngos gzhi rnams grub nas/ dbang gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes pas dam tshig 'dzin par khas blangs nas/ dbang thob pa'i gtang rag tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal dang*/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ma zad lus dang longs spyod thams cad slob dpon la 'bul/ cha shas kyis longs spyod du gsol snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// zhes sogs brjod du gzhug go /de rnams kyis grub pa'i slob dpon chen po dze tā ri'i zhal snga nas kyis bkral ba'i tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan pa yin pas rang dang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa zhu zhes dang*/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa zhes sogs brjod cing slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*// smras pa/ e ma gang sku bsgom zhing gsang ba'i sngags// bzlas pa tsam gyis 'chi med bcud len du// byed pa'i phan yon ji snyed gsungs pa yang*// dbang bskur 'di med thams cad brag ca 'dra// de yang bsnyen sogs byas pa'i rnal 'byor pas// yang dag cho gas dbang bskur bya dgos kyi// bsgrig legs tshig gi phreng ba ring spangs nas// grong tshig dbyangs su len pa gad mo'i rgyu// de phyir 'di tsam gyis kyang blo dman la// phan pa'i bsam pas bris pa'i dge ba yis// 'gro rnams gshin rje'i dgra las rnam rgyal te// mthar thug 'chi med mgon po mngon gyur cig

/de ltar tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor 'chi med grub pa'i lam bzang gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni mkhas btsun dge ba'i bshes gnyen bkra shis dpal bzang gis dkyus kyi mtshams sbyor gtso bor bton pa'i gsal byed 'di bzhin dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ chos smra ba'i btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen gyis sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i 'chi bslu'i cho ga dal rten ring 'tshor sgrub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// dpag yas bskal par bsgrubs pa'i yon tan tshogs// lus can bde legs gsos su 'khyil ba'i sku// nyi gzhon 'od khyab bye ru'i lhun po bzhin// lham mer 'bar ba 'chi med mgon pos srungs// mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug tor dze tā ri'i// zhal lung byin rlabs drod ldan dus 'dzin gyi// chad las dpung gis lhags kyang mi 'jigs par// sgo gsum pha lam rdo rjer brling bar byed// rdzas sngags bsam gtan bden pas gya nom dngos// rgya cher spel ba'i glud kyis bslu shes na// dal rten 'tsho ba nyi bu'i khar chud kyang*// bskal par 'tsho ba sngags kyi zab khyad yin// 'dir bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs kyi lhag pa'i lha tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga dang rjes su 'brel ba'i 'chi bslu'i cho ga slob dpon dze tā ri'i zhal snga nas bkral ba bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa las legs par 'ongs pa'i tshul de sgrub pa la gsum ste/ gang gis sgrub pa'i gang zag ji ltar bsgrub bya'i cho ga de ltar bsgrubs pa'i phan yon no// dang po ni bya ba'i rgyud tshe dpag tu med pa'i mdo mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas cho ga'i yan lag 'ga' zhig rnal 'byor rgyud dang mthun par bkral ba'i tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la brten pas/

'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs dang sbyar ba'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i bka' srol gnyis char ram/ gnyis ka ma thob kyang snga ma de'i dbang bskur ba legs par thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa/ las rung gi bsnyen pa sngon du song zhing 'di'i lag len mthong ba dang bcas pa'i gang zag zhig go /gnyis pa ji ltar bsgrub bya'i cho ga la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi cho ga gsum las/ dang po dkyil 'khor la dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i lam bzang las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bsham pa dang*/ 'chi bslu'i yo byad ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du slob dpon gyi gdan 'ong bar byas pa'i mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ bum pa gnyis kha rgyan sogs gang dgos dang*/ lhor tshe dpag med kyi mdo/ nub tu dar dmar po'am ras dmar gang rung la tshe dpag med kyi gzungs sam/ snying po gang rung ngam gnyis char dang*/ gzhan yang gshin rje'i gshed dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags ring bris pa smyug ma la btags pa gzugs/ byang du 'chi med rnga sgra'i mdo khri'u'i steng na gzhag pa dang*/ phyogs der ku sha'i gdan la bsgrub bya'i glud gos bltab pa tshon skud kha dog lngas rgya gram du bcings pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma bzhi la rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i dar gyi cod paṇa dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhal phyogs par bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su snod gas chag med par 'brang rgyas lha bshos sam nor bu 'bar ba'i dbyibs lta bu'i zlum po rtse mo cung zad rno ba phyed bkas su byas nas sbyar ba phyed mar gyis dkar por byugs pa la mar gi lha bshos lnga btsugs pa/ phyed nag por byas pa la dpal 'bar lnga btsugs pa dkar po'i ngos dkyil 'khor la bstan te gzhag slob dpon gyis bum pa'i chu la las sngags a mṛ ta brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i chus bsgrub bya la khrus byas pa'i phyed ni kham por gsar pa'i nang du blugs nas 'o ma dang dug cung zad bsres pa dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su gzhag

phyed kyis sāts+tsha'am mchod rten rnying pa'i sa dang ro thal/ rdza ma bsregs thal/ dur khrod kyi sa/ tshig ma'i phye ma rnams sa nag dang bsres pa sbrus te/ 'chi bdag gi gzugs khru gang pa mdog nag po ma he'i mgo can rab tu 'jigs shing khros pa'i rnam pa can/ lag pa g.yas pas ral gri'am thod pas mtshan pa'i dbyug pa/ g.yon pas zhags pa nag po thogs pa'i gzugs byas pa/ sla nga'i nang du cung zad kha sbub pa'i tshul du yod par byas te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho ngos su re ba nag po'i gdan la kha lhor bltas su gzhag steng nas dar ras nag pos bkab bo// dkyil 'khor dang gshin rje'i gzugs de'i bar la sogs pa rnams su rdzongs kyi rgyu rnyed na me tog nag po/ dug sna/ nas nag sran ma nag po la sogs pa'i 'bru dang*/ sha dmar/ mar thud/ bu ram/ tshwa la sogs pa'i zas sna dang*/ gser dngul la sogs pa rin po che dang*/ dar ras la sogs pa nor sna gang 'dzom dang*/ de dag 'jal byed kyi bre/ bsgrub bya'i lo grangs kyi ri mo can gyi zho cha srang rnams kyang bzos te bsham/ gzhan yang nya sha skam po'i spos dang*/ gri so ma dang*/ dug sna tshogs kyi phye ma rnams kyang nyer bsdogs bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba/ gshin rje la bya ba/ bsgrub bya la bya ba ste gsum las/ dang po ni rang nyid sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pas gdan la 'khod de/ sems can thams cad 'chi bdag gi chad pa las thar par byas nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la gzhag snyam pa'i sems bskyed kyis zin pas/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i lam bzang mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ bum bzlas/ gtor ma yan tsam mam/ dbang bskur byed na bdag 'jug dang bcas pa bya/ dbang bskur mi byed na'ang bdag 'jug blangs na byin rlabs che'o// 'on kyang rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma ni 'og tu 'byung bas 'dir mi dbul lo// gnyis pa ni/
slob dpon gyis/ bre la/

'ga' zhig tu/ oṃ aṣ+ya sarba tsi murti thibs swā hā zhes pa'ang byung*/ oṃ aṣ+mas wa sa tsi swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ srang la/ oṃ thib ta mthong ba'i rgyal po la swā hā/ gser zho dang srang gnyis ka la/ oṃ ma ti pra mo dha na thib swā hā/ zhes pa rnams lha 'dre mig bsgyur gyi sngags yin pas slob dpon gyis nyer gcig re shub bus bzlas te gdab/ sngags kyi sgra gzhan gyis ma thos par byed ces gsung ngo*// de'i tshe gzhan gyis sngar gyi gshin rje'i gzugs bkab pa bsal te/ sla nga nas zhal dkyil 'khor la phyogs par bzhag yo byad thams cad la chu gtsang gis sbyangs la/ chos nyid rnam dag gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas rdzas rnams kyi skyon sbyangs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ na maḥsar+b+ba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsar+b+ba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hās rgyas par spel/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bdud rtsir bsgyur/ rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi phyag rgya dang*/ na maḥsar+b+ba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐ gis rang rang 'dod pa thob par byas/ ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ dz+nyā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi sam+bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da ya swā hās rang dbang thob par byas/ dbang sgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang*/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañja ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hās mgron rnams mnyes pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ sngags de rnams lan gsum gsum brjod do// de nas 'chi bdag gi gzugs la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las las kyi gshin rje mdog nag po ma he'i gdong pa can/

g.yas ral gri byas kyang chog thod dbyug g.yon pa zhags pa nag po thogs pa/ 'khor bdud rigs bzhi'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur zhes dang*/ spro na/ 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol nas/ sogs kyis spyan 'dren gdangs dbyangs rol mo dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste gang rigs byas te spyan drangs nas/ 'khor bdud rigs bzhis bskor ba dang bcas pa la thim par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas te/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis 'chi bdag chen po 'khor dang bcas pa che ge mo'i 'chi bslu srog glud len pa la skad cig thang cig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas dgug gzhug lan gsum byas te bstim mo// de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i phyag gi bum pa'i nang du bsgrub bya bsams la/ de la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsol bar bsam/ khyad par de dag gi thugs ka nas mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam pa can du gyur pas/ bsgrub bya'i bla tshe dang bsod nams bdud dang gshin rje mthu chen gyis bcings shing dbang du byas pa thams cad tshur bsdus nas bsgrub bya la thim pas tshe srog nyams pa thams cad sor chud nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam zhing gzungs bzla/ de'i tshe sgrub grogs gcig gis lho nas tshe mdo 'don/ gcig gis byang nas 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs 'don/ glud gos la nya sha'i dud pas bdug sgrub grogs gzhan rnams kyis tshe gzungs 'don zhing*/ tshar re song ba'i rjes la/

nas gro/ sha mar thud gser dngul sogs bre grangs/ khal grangs/ zho grangs/ srang grangs rnams re re nas bgrangs pa'i brgya stong sogs bgrang dgos kyang*/ de tsam mi 'grub pas snga ma brgya rtsa'am/ lo grangs sogs sgra ji bzhin pa dang*/ de nas gcig bcu/ brgya/ stong*/ khri/ 'bum/ sa ya/ bye ba/ dung phyur mang po byas te rdzongs 'debs/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul zhing*/ byang gi 'chi med rnga sgra'i mdo 'don mkhan gyis gzungs tshar re thon pa dang*/ glud gos tshon skud dang bcas pa la nya sha'i dud pas bdug cing*/ 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na// bde ba can gyi zhing khams su// skye rga na 'chi'i ming yang med// de na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni// de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med// su zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin pa// skye rga na 'chi las grol nas// bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas// nad dang sdug bsngal kun bral nas// tshe dpag med pa'i sku thob shog /ces brjod de/ mdo gnyis kyi grangs brgya rtsa gcig gam ma mtha' bsgrub bya'i lo grangs re bya zhing*/ 'di'i skabs su sgrub g.yog rnams kyis kyang gzungs 'don pa dang*/ bre dang srang gis 'jal ba dang*/ grangs brjod pa ma gtogs tha mal gyi gtam gzhan smra mi rung*/ bya ba thams cad don med du 'gyur ba'i rgyur gsungs pas rtsed mo dang gad mo la sogs pa'ang mi bya/ sems kyis chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur rten 'brel gyi gzugs brnyan yin/ ji ltar rdzongs byed pa'i rdzas de rnams dngos po bzang zhing rgya che ba 'chi bdag 'khor bcas la byin pas tshim zhing bsgrub bya'i tshe srog bslus par bsams la/ rdzas rnams bre srang dang gser zho la 'jal zhing 'chi bdag gi rdzongs kyi phyir de'i gzugs kyi mdun du dor/ mthar bre srang sogs kyang bcag la dor/

gzungs kyi grangs them pa dang*/ dpon slob thams cad kyis/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// gshin rje'i mgron la gang byin pa// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// 'jig rten khams 'di ma lus pa// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces brjod la 'chi bdag gi gzugs la me tog gtor/ de nas rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma bsang sbyangs byin rlabs 'das gtor ltar byas nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ e h+ye hi tsa tur ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir bzhugs par bsams la/ oṃ dhṛ ta rāṣ+ṭa sogs mtshan sngags bzhi la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod pas mchod/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa sogs kyis bstod/ rgyal po chen po 'khor bcas sogs nas kun 'grub shog gis phrin las bcol/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'brang rgyas phyed mar gshags te/ nag po ngos la mar me lnga sbar ba dang bsgrub bya bkrus pa'i chu kham phor dang bcas pa gshin rje'i gzugs de'i mdun gyi sla nga'i nang du bzhag ste/ 'brang rgyas sngar byin gyis brlabs zin pa chu gtsang gis sbyangs/ oṃ sar+b+ba bigh+nān/ na mas+sar+b+ba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs kyis gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa la lam brgyags kyi tshul du bsngos/ rang tshe dpag med kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas 'di skad brjod de/ 'di nas lho yi zhes pa nas mthu rlabs can zhes bya ba'i bar dang*/ 'khor bcas 'dir ni bdag la nyon// chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i tshogs// 'chi bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams la// deng 'dir che ge mo zhes pa'i// tshe dang srog gi glud 'bul gyis// 'dod yon rin chen sna lnga dang*// 'bru dang mchod yon sna tshogs dang*// zhal zas me tog la sogs mchod// glud 'di longs la tshe srog byin// bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol// bka' dang dam las ma 'da' zhig

/khyed kyi 'khor gyi yi dwags rnams// bza' ba bzang po 'di 'bul gyis// 'di zo 'khor gyi yi dwags rnams// ma 'tshe bar ni gzhan du dengs// spro na/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la zhes pa nas kun 'grub mdzod ces pa'i bar brjod/ de nas/ rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang zhes pa nas gdon rnams rang rang gnas su dengs zhes brjod/ de nas dpon slob thams cad bzhengs te/ slob dpon gyis gshin rje'i sla nga la rdo rjes reg tsam byas nas/ gshin rje'i kha phyir bstan la rdzongs rnams kyang de'i mdun du 'ong bar byas nas sngar bzhin bden pa bdar te/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis sbyin pa'i bdag po'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i 'chi bdag gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol tu song zhig na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta sogs khro bo'i sngags mang du brjod cing rol mo dang bcas pas 'chi bdag gi gzugs dang lhan cig tu rdzongs chas dang gtor ma khrus chu sogs lho phyogs kyi grong zad par bskyel la kha lhor bstan la/ rdzongs chas rnams kyang de'i mdun du gzhag skyel mkhan rnams nang du log dus phyi mig mi blta ba gnad du che'o// de nas bsgrub bya mdun du tsog pur 'khod du bcug la/ glud gos kyi tshon skud bkrol nas/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang dril bu thogs bzhin pas lag len ltar mdud khug btab ste bsgrub bya'i ske dang*/ lag pa'i srin mdzub gnyis dang rkang pa'i mthe bong rnams su bcing*/ nad pa lta bu'i tsog 'dug mi tshugs pa rnams la g.yon pa kho na la bcings pas btub ces gsung*/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad do// khyed rang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med par gsal ba la mos gus byas pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer rno zhing thogs pa med pa lcags kyu'i rnam pa can grangs med pa 'phros/

khyed rang gi lus kyi phyi nang dang snod bcud thams cad du khyab pas/ khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la bar du gcod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin par 'chi bar byed pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'od zer sngo dmar dang dud khu sol khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pa can dang*/ gdon bgegs la sogs pa sdig sbal dang srog chags mi sdug pa'i rnam pa can du tshur bkug ste lus la bcings pa'i tshon skud 'di la sib kyis thim par mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ rje btsun rtsa ba sogs kyi bden bdar gong bzhin brjod pa'i bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhes bya ba'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i rgyu nyon mongs pa dug lnga dang*/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i nad rims gdon bgegs mi dang mi ma yin pas byas pa'i byad dang byur sogs bar du gcod pa thams cad lus la bcings pa'i tshon skud sna lnga po 'di la thim par gyur cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang gi lus la bcings pa'i tshon skud 'di nyid nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'dus pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur par mos pa mdzod/ ral gri me'i dbal dang chur bcug pa thogs nas/ slob dpon tshe dpag tu med par gsal bas ye shes kyi ral gri me dang chus ngar dang ldan par byas pa de nyid kyis tshon skud rnams dum bur bcad pas bar du gcod pa thams cad dang bral bar byas par mos pa mdzod ces brjod la 'di skad do// gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang*// tshangs pa dang ni 'jig rten skyong*// gnod sbyin sde dpon dbang phyug che// de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa rnams// de dag mthu dang gzi brjid kyis// che ge mo la gnod gyur pa'i// byad stems las rnams chad gyur cig

/oṃ na mo bh+rūṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na hrīḥ.a ro lika hūm̐ hrīḥzhes dang*/ oṃ sar+b+ba ban+dhā nāṃ ka khorda ts+tshe da nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing g.yon dril bu dang bcas tshon skud rgyab ngos nas bzung*/ g.yas pas ral gri'i so phyir bstan te mgrin pa'i dang de bzhin du lag pa gnyis dang rkang pa gnyis kyi tshon skud rnams bcad/ bcad pa'i dum bus bsgrub bya la phyir bskor zhing bsags/ slar yang las kyi rdo rjes dum bu mang du bcad do// de nas slob dpon gyi phyag g.yon pas tshon skud dum bu bzung*/ g.yas pas tshon skud kyi dum bu re re dang snying po dang a mṛ ta brjod cing las bum gyi chu thigs re rnams sngar gyi kham phor 'o chab can gyi nang du dor/ bsgrub bya'i nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bsam zhing lan mang du bya/ slar yang slob dpon gyi phyag g.yon pas dug sna bzung*/ g.yas pas bsgrub bya'i mgo la bskor nas chu'i nang du dor zhing*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo// zhes dang*/ chos dang dge 'dun la'ang de bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o// sa ni dug gi pha yin te// sa ni dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// che ge'i dug ni dug med shog /dug ni sa yi nang du song*// gang ba'i nang du dug song zhig swā hā/ yang spro na/ sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug nges par bcom mo// de bzhin du dug nges par bcom mo zhes kun la sbyar te/ rang sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis= dgra bcom pa'i gzi brjid kyis= phyir mi 'ong ba'i gzi brjid kyis= lan cig phyir 'ong gi gzi brjid kyis= rgyun du zhugs pa'i gzi brjid kyis= bden par smra ba'i gzi brjid kyis= tshangs pa'i be con gyis= dbang po'i rdo rjes= khyab 'jug gi 'khor los=

me lha'i dbal gyis= chu lha'i zhags pas= lha ma yin gyi rgyud kyis= klu'i rig sngags kyis= drag po'i mdung rtses= skem byed kyi mdung thung gis dug nges par bcom mo// dug sa'i nang du song zhig de bzhin du sa'i gnas su chu me rlung rnams la'ang 'don pa bsgyur te brjod mthar khrus chu glud gos dang bcas pa byang phyogs kyi grong zad pa'i sar bskyal lo// de nas skabs 'dir dbang bskur byed na de bzhin dang*/ mi byed na sbyang ba spyi ltar dang bkru byabs bsrung gsum byas la/ slob dpon gyis 'brang rgyas dkar po thogs la/ thams cad kyis phun sum tshogs pa sogs kyi bkra shis brjod cing me tog gtor te bsgrub bya'i lag tu gtad cing*/ bkra shis tshe brtan dpal gyi zas// snying po bsdus pa'i bcud 'di ni// de ring bu yis bza' bar gyis// 'di zos sangs rgyas tshe dpag med// zhal zas bsten pas nad kun las// grol 'gyur the tshom bya mi dgos// oṃ tad+ya thā a pa ri mi tā ā yur+dz+nyā na hrīḥhūm̐ bh+rūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing slob mas 'brang rgyas bza'o// 'di ni bsgrub bya la dngos su byed pa'i dbang du byas la/ gal te dngos su stabs ma bde na dbang bskur dor ba ma gtogs cho ga gzhan 'dra'o// gsum pa phan yon bstan pa ni/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas 'chi ba nges par bslu ba ni tshe dpag tu med pa'i mdo mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang*/ 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs la sogs pa'i rgyud dang*/ dze tā ris bkral ba'i tshe dpag med lha dgu'i cho ga'i gzhung rnams kyis dngos su bstan pa dang slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas 'chi bdag bslu ba'i rtogs pa las/ lus dang ngag gi las kyis phyi// bsam gtan las kyi nang gis yin// nor bu sngags sman phyi yis te// rnal 'byor nus pas nang yin no// zhes 'chi bslu'i rnam grangs mang du gsungs pa las/ 'di ni mchog tu gyur pa phyi nang gnyis kar brten pa gsang sngags kyi gdams pa'i cho ga zab mo'i sgo nas 'chi ba bslu ba'i thabs dri ma med pa brgyud pa'i byin rlabs ma nyams pa'i bka' srol te/

mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i zhal snga nas/ de ltar dri med rgyud gzhung las gsungs pa// 'khrul med brgyud pa'i bka' srol ma nyams pa// 'di 'dra nyams su len pa'i skal bzang rnams// nad med tshe dang lang tsho'i dpal thob 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar rtogs par bya'o// zhes skal ba bzang ldan gyi gang zag rnams kyi tshe'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs bla na med pa nyid do// smras pa/ kun mkhyen gyis gsungs dag byed gter gyi bcud// grub dbang skabs gsum dbang pos bsten bya ba// dal rten lha lus rga shi med pa'i gsos// bdag yid rnam sad gzhon nus 'di na blangs// tshul 'dis mi gsal lag len gsal bar byed// gzhan du ma tshang yan lag tshang bar byed// lung rigs ma 'brel dogs kyang 'bel bar bsgrubs// 'di 'dra gang gis shes de'ang shes ldan smros// yid 'phrog dri yi bzhon pas lho yi nags// bskyod kyin byung bas tsha gdung nyen pa'i lus// sngon med bde bar ngal gsor thob pa'i glu// swa sti yi ge dbyangs su len gyur cig /ces bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i 'chi bslu'i cho ga dal rten ring 'tshor sgrub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba 'di ni nye bar gnas pa kun dga' bsam gtan gyis nan tan du bskul ba'i ngor/ dze tā ri'i rgya gzhung dang*/ rje ngor chen dkon mchog dpal ldan pa dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad pa'i 'chi bslu'i cho ga gzhir bzhag gzhan yang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub pas mdzad pa rnams la'ang gtugs te mi gsal ba dang kha 'gengs 'khrugs sdebs 'os pa rnams brgyud pa'i phyag len gyi tshul la 'dris par byas nas/ lag tu blang bde bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung 'dod pa'i na tshod ldan te shing phag gi gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dus tshes dge bar sbyar ba sems can thams cad la phan thogs par gyur cig

phyis su rgya chen chos spyan yangs pa chos rje bstan 'dzin rdo rje pas mdzad pa'i 'chi bslu'i cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i lam bzang mdzes pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba thun mong min pa'i dmigs pa dang rgyal chen bzhi po so so la gtor 'bul phrin las gzhol ba sogs shin tu 'brel chags pa zhig kyang mjal byung bas cung zad spros par 'dod pas de bzhin du byas kyang legs pa zhig tu mngon no// //sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// sgra mi snyan gyi rang gzungs kyi gdams pa'i gsal byed yid ches sum ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// gang gi zhal lung 'chi med grub pa'i chus// bskal par 'tsho ba'i rgyal sar dbang bskur mkhan// bla ma dus dgra'i mgon la phyag 'tshal nas// 'chi med rang gzungs rnam dag yi ger bstar// bya ba'i rgyud kyi rig sngags bcangs tsam gyis// skye ba dran pa'i gzi byin stong 'bar ba// yi ge lnga bcu bdun pa'i bdag nyid can// bslab kun btus par lus srung sngags su bshad// gzhan du byang gi sgra mi snyan pa yi// tshe yi rang gzungs zhes bya'i gdams pa 'dir// lo rgyus gdams pa dngos dang mjug gsum las// dang por yongs grags dgra bcom blo gros dpal// zhes byas klu sgrub phug par lo bcu gcig /sgrub pa mdzad pa'i nang gcig tho rangs khar// paṇ+ḍi ta yi cha lugs 'chang zhig gis// byung ba de yi ngag nas nga nyid ni// nā gardzu na zhes bya de na re// mi dkar zhig gis lam sna 'dren 'ong gis// gang tshe khyed nyid 'di ru ma sdod par// bal bod mtshams song sgrub pa gyis shig dang*// lung bstan 'ong gi gsungs nas mi snang gyur// nam zhig mi dkar gyis byung bal bod mtshams// nags khrod dben pa cig tu khrid de der// bde bar bag phab nyin mor chab gtor 'bad// rtag tu ting nge 'dzin la mnyam bzhag pas// bde bar gshegs las lung bstan thob pa dang*// sha yi spyan gyis gling bzhi gzigs pa dang*// nam 'chi nges mkhyen chab gtor btang ba na// mi ma yin pa mang po 'du ba byung*// lan gcig mi ma yin pa mang po dag

/mya ngan smre sngags 'don mthong der byon nas// rgyu mtshan bris pas da ste zhag bdun nas// dgra bcom khyed ni 'grongs par shes nas ngu*// zhes zer de bzhin ngas kyang shes mod kyi// khyed cag ngus pas phan pa mchis sam ci// 'chi bar mi 'gyur thabs shig mi ma yin// khyed cag rnams la med dam zhes gsungs par// lha 'dre gzhan rnams nged la ci yod zer// de nang lha yi dge bsnyen yin zer ba// mig g.yas long dang rkang g.yon 'theng ba zhig /mi 'chi'i thabs de sgra mi snyan gling na// 'chi med rang gzungs zhes su bya ba mchis// gzungs de bgrangs pas lus la rgas pa med// 'chi med tshe lo stong phrag thub pa yod// ces zer 'o na de nyid len nus su// dris pa'i lan du dge bsnyen de na re// nga yis nus zer de la dgra bcom pas// khyod ni mig ya long dang rkang pa 'theng*// gling gzhan thag ring bgrod par mi nus sam// lus 'dis 'gro min rdzu 'phrul mthu yis so// 'o na lo gcig tshun chad lon nam gsungs// lo gcig 'gor na khyod la phan pa ci// de bas ma grongs tsam du slebs zhes song*// byang gi sgra mi snyan nas blangs te byung*// dgra bcom la phul gzungs de bklag pa'i mthus// lo grangs stong thub dgra bcom 'chi med grags// de yis bal po ha ngu tsan+d+rar stsal// lo brgya lon no des kyang dar ma grags// zhes bya la gnang lo grangs nyis brgyar thub// de la mnga' ris dpal chen rgyal ba grub// drug cur son tshe gdams pa 'di thob pas// lo brgyar lon yang lus stobs chung ma song*// de las slob dpon ye shes rgyal bas zhus// lo grangs sum brgyar thub bo de las kyang*// slob dpon

shes rab grags zhes pa'ang byung*/ shes rgyal gyis zhus nyis brgya'i lo// lon nas dbus kyi lha sar lan gnyis bskor// de la dz+nyā na sid+dhi de las kyang*// sangs rgyas grags kyis yon du yum bar ma// bum pa brgya skyes zho dos maṇ+ḍal bcas// nan tan gsol ba btab gnang de nas rim// rtogs ldan rin chen bzang dang lcags lung gi /gzhon nu blo gros paṇa chen shāka mchog dang*// gzhon nu chos grub sogs las rim bzhin brgyud// tshul 'di zhu dus yon dbul dka' spyad sogs// bla ma mnyes pa'i zhal las blang bya'o// gnyis pa nyams su blang tshul tho rengs dus// skyabs gsum yon tan rjes su dran pa'i blos// gzhan don byang chub bsgrub phyir tshe bsrings nas// rgyal sras spyad pa spyod snyam 'di skad brjod// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la// byang chub bar du bdag nyid skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum sogs kyis skyabs 'gro sems mchog bskyed// rang nyid pad+ma dkar po 'dab bzhi'i steng*// tha mal rang lus hūm̐ yig mthing gar gyur// de las lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa// 'od kyi rang bzhin gyur pa'i lte bar hūm̐// sngags kyi phreng ba dkar pos bskor bar gsal// tshig gzhan dag gis bar ma chad par bzlas// yang na brgyud pa gong ma'i lugs ltar na// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar bya ba dang*// swa bhā wa sogs sngags kyis stong par bsgom// de yi ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dkar// 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba la gnas pa'i// gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte ba'i nang*// rang nyid bcom ldan rgyal ba tshe dpag med// sku mdog dmar po mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin// rgyan ldan mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar bar gsal// de yi lus dbus drang por srog rtsa ni// lcags kyi srog shing rdo rje rtse lnga'i dbyibs// lte bar rang sems hūm̐ yig mthing nag mthar// sngags phreng g.yas skor yod par klog tshul bzlas// sngags ni 'di'o// na mo bud+dhā ya/

na mo dhar+m+mā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ tad+ya thā/ iṭ+ṭe/ baṭ+ṭe/ naṭ+ṭe/ ku naṭ+ṭe/ ṭak+ke/ ṭhak+ke/ ṭha rak+ke/ u ru ma ti/ ru ru ma ti/ ru ru hil+li mil+li/ sab+ba dz+nyā/ du pa dag+ga na maḥsab+ba/ sam+ma sa mudz+dzhānī/ sidz+dzhan+tu me man+t+ra pā dāḥswā hā/ zhes dang*/ lugs gcig la/ iṭ+ṭe/ waṭ+ṭe/ naṭ+ṭe/ ku naṭ+ṭe/ ṭa ke ṭha ke ṭha ra ke u ru ma ti/ ru ru ma ti/ ru ru hi li mi li/ sarba dz+nyā/ stsi bi sa dag+ga/ na maḥsam+ba/ sa ma bud+dhā nāṃ/ sid+dh+yan+tu me man+t+ra pā hāḥswā hāḥ phyi ma 'di legs sbyar gyi lugs shas che bar bzhed do/ /zhes pa brgya rtsa la sogs ci nus bzlas/ gsum pa de mthar dge ba bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob gyur nas// byang chub spyod pa'i rgya mtsho legs spyad cing*// bstan dang sems can phan pa bsgrub par shog /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje la sogs pas// bsngos pa 'grub pa'i bden stobs brjod par bya// gzungs sngags zab mo'i rang bzhin rno dbal dang*// rtsub mo'i reg bya 'dzin par mi byed mod// 'chi bdag chad pa'i nus pa skad cig nyid// phye mar bdar ba'i nus pa rdzogs gyur cig /ces sgra mi snyan gyi rang gzungs kyi gdams pa'i gsal byed yid ches sum ldan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'di'i skor gyi yig cha lo rgyus yod med dang*/ zhal shes can sogs mang zhig thos kyang sngags kyi tshig la sngar nas ma dag pa'i rgyun zhugs par phal cher yig mkhan gyis bslad pa'i rgyus ltang gcod dka' bar mchis par/ bslab btus nas 'byung ba dang sa skya lo tsā'i gsung bzhin ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas legs sbyar dang zur chag gi lugs kyi zhus dag so sor mdzad pa dang*/ zhwa lu lo chen gyis zhus dag mdzad pa skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas pa'i thugs la mnga' ba'i lung bcas legs par nos nas/

de dag gtsor gzung gi zhus bstun dang bcas te nyams su blang bde bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa ā yurbi stā ra bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
